policy.deduplication: Exact size plus SHA-256 matches are referenced, not duplicated.
policy.large_binary: Large scientific binaries/checkpoints are not inserted into ordinary Git history solely for custody.
policy.integrity: No artifact is labeled byte-preserved unless remote bytes reproduce the expected digest.
policy.scientific_authority: Custody does not create or broaden scientific authority.
policy.branch_scope: Documentation/custody/handoff only; no model, training, threshold, test-result, or production scientific-state mutation.
